architectural_decisions.title: Vite + Vanilla TypeScript over Heavy Framework for Single-Page Storyboard
architectural_decisions.context: Initial reverse engineering revealed khanhnguyen.design was built with Astro v6. For a local single-page interactive experience with heavy GSAP and Lenis DOM manipulations, React or Vue adds unnecessary virtual-DOM overhead, while Astro is multi-page oriented. Vite + TypeScript provides raw DOM performance, zero overhead, and instant HMR.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Ultra-fast load times (dist JS < 155kB gzipped), direct GSAP timeline control without React useEffect/ref lifecycle collisions.

architectural_decisions.title: Continuous Mathematical Fluid Scaling Token (--scale)
architectural_decisions.context: Traditional responsive design uses discrete breakpoints (sm/md/lg/xl) which cause abrupt reflows and text wrap shifts on ultrawide, tablet, or unusual laptop viewports.
architectural_decisions.decision: Implement continuous proportional scale formula: calc(100vw / 144) on desktop (1440px baseline) and calc(100vw / 39) on mobile (390px baseline). All spacing (--vg), typography (--display-fs, --name-fs), and container dimensions derive strictly from multiples of --scale.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Pixel-perfect geometric preservation at any aspect ratio (Ultrawide 3440x1440, MacBook 1728x1117, 1080p, 4K).

architectural_decisions.title: Dual-Axis Spatial Experience (Horizontal Storyboard + Vertical Stack)
architectural_decisions.context: Desktop experience requires an expansive, architectural horizontal journey, whereas mobile viewports must maintain intuitive, native vertical swipe ergonomics.
architectural_decisions.decision: GSAP ScrollTrigger pins the viewport on desktop and translates window.scrollY to track.translateX. On viewports < 768px, ScrollTrigger unpins and the document seamlessly renders as a vertical stacked stream.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Flawless native mobile feel while maintaining Awwwards-tier cinematic desktop presence.

architectural_decisions.title: Monochromatic Greyscale Palette over Earthy Tones
architectural_decisions.context: Initial reverse engineering extracted warm parchment (#faf9f6) and espresso (#2e2b28). The user specifically critiqued this as a ditto copy of khanhnguyen.design and requested pure black and white / greyscale to match the rigor of CS & Mathematics.
architectural_decisions.decision: Transformed palette into pure high-contrast obsidian slate (#000000, #080808, #0a0a0a), stark white (#ffffff), and subtle hairline boundary dividers (#1f1f1f, #222222, #e5e5e5). Alternating chapter tones create dynamic contrast.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Eliminated warm agency tones, establishing a dignified, academic, and mathematically disciplined atmosphere.

architectural_decisions.title: Full-Page Vertical Views over Side-Drawer Modals
architectural_decisions.context: Initial slide-over drawer squeezed archive content into 40% of the screen, creating a desolate 60% black void, horizontal code scrollbars, and feeling like an afterthought.
architectural_decisions.decision: Replaced side drawer with two dedicated full-page vertical views: #vertical-archive-view (slides up from bottom for View All Experience and Projects) and #vertical-article-view (slides in from top for individual research essays). Centered 56rem and 48rem editorial reader containers with ESC dismissal.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Rich, distraction-free reading experience with ample whitespace and zero code truncation.

architectural_decisions.title: Standalone CMS Studio with Storyboard Curation & Display Limits
architectural_decisions.context: User requested a fully fledged CMS for all updatable sections (Projects, Experience, Blogs, Identity) with sensible display limits on the main storyboard so it does not get cluttered.
architectural_decisions.decision: Created cms.html and src/cms.ts powered by cmsStore.ts. Features: configurable upper limits (default 3), one-click toggle between Highlight on Storyboard vs Drawer/Archive Only, full CRUD, localStorage persistence, and JSON backup/restore. Removed all CMS links from user-facing UI for clean public presentation.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Complete autonomous content management without rebuilding the project; zero visual clutter on the public portfolio.

architectural_decisions.title: Balanced Minimalism & Selective Monospace Typography
architectural_decisions.context: User critiqued excessive use of monospace fonts everywhere and random telemetry clutter (fake brackets, [INIT_SEQUENCE], cyber-HUDs).
architectural_decisions.decision: Newsreader serif for monumental titles, Plus Jakarta Sans for body/subtitles, and JetBrains Mono strictly reserved for dates, quantitative metrics, code snippets, and London UTC clock.
architectural_decisions.consequences: Polished editorial typography free from pseudo-hacker AI slop.
